ℹ️ What is Collateral Duty? tap to expand
Collateral Duty is non-emergency time you spend supporting the company — for example: station and apparatus maintenance, gear and equipment checks, standby or sleep-in coverage, fundraiser and special-event setup, and administrative or committee work.
Clock in when you begin and clock out when you finish so your time is recorded accurately.
LOSAP credit: 1 point per 4 hours of collateral duty, up to 20 points per year (AACVFA §3c).

Drill Report

📋 How it works: For past drills — fill out the form and submit. The report goes directly to officer approvals.
For future drills — selecting a future date automatically creates a Company Drill event on the Staffing calendar. All selected members are signed up. When the last member clocks out of the event, the drill report is automatically submitted for officer approval.

Raw Data Export & Reset
Export JSON/CSV or clear all data
▶
Download a full backup of all portal data as a JSON file. Store it somewhere safe — this is your disaster recovery copy if Firebase ever needs to be restored. Restore reads a backup file back in, shows you what will change, then syncs it to every device.

Google Calendar

Admin ▼

Members connect their personal Google Calendar once — after that, every shift, meeting, and event they sign up for automatically appears on their calendar without any extra steps.

Paste the OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Web Application type) from Google Cloud Console ↗. In the console: APIs & Services → Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth Client ID → Web Application. Add your portal URL as both an Authorized JavaScript Origin and an Authorized Redirect URI.

What is LOSAP?

LOSAP (Length of Service Award Program) is a Maryland state benefit program that rewards active volunteer fire and EMS members for their service to the community.

Members who earn 50 or more points in a calendar year qualify for active service credit. Training points are tiered: 6-19 hrs = 5 pts, 20-44 hrs = 10 pts, 45+ hrs = 15 pts. Points must be earned in at least two categories to qualify.

How Points Are Earned
🚒 Emergency Response
0.5 pt each, no max
🏛 Meeting
1 pt each (max 20)
📚 Formal Training
5/10/15 pts by hrs (max 25)
🔧 Drill/In-House
1 pt per drill (max 10)
🕐 Standby/Sleep-In/Duty
1 pt per 4-hr block (max 20)
🏅 Elected Officer
25 pts/yr (max 25)
🏅 Committee Chair
15 pts/yr (max 25)
🏅 Committee Member
10 pts/yr (max 25)

Questions? Contact your LOSAP Committee Chair or visit AACVFA LOSAP Manual v4.1 for official program details.

CAD Gmail Sync Setup

5-step setup — no Google Cloud Console required.

Step 1 — Gmail Label & Filter
Create a Gmail label CAD-Dispatch and set up a filter to apply it to incoming CAD emails.
Step 2 — Google Sheet
Create a new Google Sheet. Copy the Sheet ID from the URL: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/SHEET_ID/edit
Step 3 — Apps Script
In the Sheet: Extensions → Apps Script. Paste the RBVFC-CAD-Sync.gs code, fill in your SHEET_ID, run once to grant permissions, then add a time-based trigger (every 30 minutes) for processDispatchEmails.
Step 4 — Deploy as Web App
Deploy → New Deployment → Web App. Execute as: Me. Who has access: Anyone. Copy the Web App URL.
Step 5 — Paste URL in Portal
Paste the Web App URL into Admin → Data Management → CAD Dispatch Sync and save.
